# TABLES
orders (30,000 rows)
  order_id VARCHAR  KEY  e.g. ord_00001, ord_00014, ord_00031
  customer_id VARCHAR  e.g. cust_01171, cust_01892, cust_01740
  order_status VARCHAR  e.g. canceled, delivered, shipped
  order_purchase_ts TIMESTAMP_NS  e.g. 2024-07-01 00:00:00, 2025-04-10 00:00:00, 2024-06-03 00:00:00
  order_approved_ts TIMESTAMP_NS  e.g. 2025-10-03 10:00:00, 2025-06-16 09:00:00, 2024-
response:
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', order_purchase_ts) AS month,
    COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM orders
WHERE DATE_TRUNC('year', order_purchase_ts) = DATE_TRUNC('year', TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01')
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month;
